findings.title: Dwellings remain a readable witness after destruction

findings.mechanism: The focus dwelling carrier is reactivated by the supplied wider dwelling scenes, which make remains function as testimony rather than background setting.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive the dwellings as the surviving evidentiary surface of the destroyed communities.
findings.containment: This keeps the ordinary sense of dwellings and does not claim that every occurrence of the root means ruins or that the proper names alone encode the dossier.

The only candidate-linked registered branch here is inner discernment (B002); all focus occurrences are possible carriers only, so global activation must return through the focus participle with a distinct wider trigger.

The b-y-n registry separates the focus form tabayyana into rupture, intermediary, relational, and disclosure branches; only disclosure B004 is candidate-linked and has the focus verb carrier. The z-y-n registry separates beauty as quality from beautifying action B002, which is candidate-linked, while multiple HFT branches remain unresolved provenance-only. These distinctions will constrain global findings to concrete focus returns.
